C0000.summary: In order for a private, nonprofit entity to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title, the entity shall administer the community services block grant program through a tripartite board that fully participates in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of the program to serve low-income communities.
C0000.scope_text: In order for a private, nonprofit entity to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title

C0001.summary: The members of the tripartite board shall be selected by the entity and the board shall be composed so as to assure that ⅓ of the members of the board are elected public officials, holding office on the date of selection, or their representatives, except that if the number of such elected officials reasonably available and willing to serve on the board is less than ⅓ of the membership of the board, membership on the board of appointive public officials or their representatives may be counted in meeting such ⅓ requirement.
C0001.scope_text: Governing the selection and composition of the tripartite board through which a private, nonprofit entity administers the community services block grant program.

C0002.summary: The tripartite board shall be composed so as to assure that not fewer than ⅓ of the members are persons chosen in accordance with democratic selection procedures adequate to assure that these members are representative of low-income individuals and families in the neighborhood served, and each representative of low-income individuals and families selected to represent a specific neighborhood within a community under clause (i) resides in the neighborhood represented by the member.
C0002.scope_text: Governing the selection and composition of the tripartite board through which a private, nonprofit entity administers the community services block grant program.

C0003.summary: The tripartite board shall be composed so as to assure that the remainder of the members are officials or members of business, industry, labor, religious, law enforcement, education, or other major groups and interests in the community served.
C0003.scope_text: Governing the selection and composition of the tripartite board through which a private, nonprofit entity administers the community services block grant program.

C0004.summary: In order for a public organization to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title, the entity shall administer the community services block grant program through either (1) a tripartite board, which shall have members selected by the organization and shall be composed so as to assure that not fewer than ⅓ of the members are persons chosen in accordance with democratic selection procedures adequate to assure that these members are representative of low-income individuals and families in the neighborhood served, reside in the neighborhood served, and are able to participate actively in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs funded under this chapter, or (2) another mechanism specified by the State to assure decisionmaking and participation by low-income individuals in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs funded under this chapter.
C0004.scope_text: In order for a public organization to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title

inventory.U0000: In order for a private, nonprofit entity to be considered an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title, the entity must administer the community services block grant program through a tripartite board that is described in paragraph (2) and that fully participates in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of the program to serve low-income communities.
inventory.U0001: The members of the tripartite board of the private nonprofit entity must be selected by the entity.
inventory.U0002: The tripartite board of the private nonprofit entity must be composed so as to assure that one-third of the members of the board are elected public officials holding office on the date of selection, or their representatives.
inventory.U0003: For the tripartite board of a private nonprofit entity, if the number of elected officials holding office on the date of selection who are reasonably available and willing to serve on the board is less than one-third of the board's membership, membership of appointive public officials or their representatives may be counted toward meeting the one-third requirement.
inventory.U0004: The tripartite board of the private nonprofit entity must be composed so as to assure that not fewer than one-third of the members are persons chosen in accordance with democratic selection procedures adequate to assure that these members are representative of low-income individuals and families in the neighborhood served.
inventory.U0005: Each representative of low-income individuals and families selected under clause (i) to represent a specific neighborhood within a community on the private nonprofit entity's tripartite board must reside in the neighborhood represented by that member.
inventory.U0006: The tripartite board of the private nonprofit entity must be composed so as to assure that the remainder of the members are officials or members of business, industry, labor, religious, law enforcement, education, or other major groups and interests in the community served.
inventory.U0007: In order for a public organization to be considered an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title, the entity must administer the community services block grant program through either a tripartite board satisfying the requirements of paragraph (1) or another mechanism specified by the State under paragraph (2).
inventory.U0008: Under the tripartite board alternative for a public organization, the board members must be selected by the organization and the board must be composed so as to assure that not fewer than one-third of the members are persons chosen in accordance with democratic selection procedures adequate to assure that they are representative of low-income individuals and families in the neighborhood served, reside in the neighborhood served, and are able to participate actively in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs funded under this chapter.
inventory.U0009: Under the alternative mechanism for a public organization, the program must be administered through another mechanism specified by the State to assure decisionmaking and participation by low-income individuals in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs funded under this chapter.

claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 faithfully captures the condition under which a private nonprofit entity must administer the CSBG program through a tripartite board that fully participates in development, planning, implementation, and evaluation.

Claim C0001 accurately covers the selection of board members by the private nonprofit entity, the requirement for 1/3 elected public officials (or their representatives), and the exception allowing appointive public officials when insufficient elected officials are available and willing to serve.

Claim C0002 captures the requirement for at least 1/3 low-income neighborhood representatives democratically selected, and the requirement that each representative reside in the neighborhood represented.

Claim C0003 correctly states that the remainder of the tripartite board members must be officials or members of business, industry, labor, religious, law enforcement, education, or other major groups and interests in the community served.

Claim C0004 completely and accurately covers the public organization requirements, including the option between a tripartite board meeting democratic selection and residency requirements and another mechanism specified by the State.

unit_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 fully retains the requirement and condition for private nonprofit entities to administer the CSBG program through a fully participating tripartite board.
Claim C0001 explicitly states that board members shall be selected by the entity.
Claim C0001 explicitly retains the composition rule requiring one-third of board members to be elected public officials holding office on the date of selection, or their representatives.
Claim C0001 explicitly retains the exception allowing appointive public officials or their representatives to count if reasonably available elected officials are fewer than one-third.
Claim C0002 includes the requirement that not fewer than one-third of members be chosen via democratic selection procedures adequate to assure representation of low-income individuals and families.
Claim C0002 explicitly incorporates the requirement that low-income representative members must reside in the specific neighborhood represented.
Claim C0003 fully covers the requirement that the remainder of the members are representatives of business, industry, labor, religious, law enforcement, education, or other major groups.
Claim C0004 covers the condition for public organizations to administer the program through either a tripartite board or a State-specified mechanism.
Claim C0004 fully retains the tripartite board branch for public organizations, including democratic selection, low-income representation, residency, and active participation.
Claim C0004 fully retains the alternative mechanism branch specified by the State for decisionmaking and participation by low-income individuals.
